original: Translation for information (the German text is binding): I expressly consent, in accordance with Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR, to MedLuxLife processing the health data I provide for the medical pre-assessment, the preparation of an offer and the organisation of my requested treatment. I have read the Consent Declaration on Health Data.

Translation for information (the German text is binding): I expressly consent, in accordance with Art. 49(1)(a) GDPR, to the personal data required for my enquiry, including health data, being transferred to the medical provider in Türkiye selected for my enquiry. I have been informed that there is no adequacy decision of the EU Commission for Türkiye and that the transfer may therefore involve particular data protection risks.
Translation for information: Both consents are voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future.
